description: Reverb built from eight comb filters and four all-pass filters, after the public-domain Freeverb algorithm

params.text: Scales the delay lengths inside the reverb, from a quarter of their nominal length to two and a half times it
Sets how much of the reverb is fed back into itself, from 0.8 to 1
Sets how much high end is lost each time the sound goes round the comb filters
Crossfades between the dry input and the reverb

inputs.text: Adds to the SIZE knob, 5V covering the whole range, and the total is held inside the knob's limits
Adds to the FEEDBACK knob, 5V covering the whole range, and the total is held inside the knob's limits
Adds to the DAMP knob, 5V covering the whole range, and the total is held inside the knob's limits
Adds to the MIX knob, 5V covering the whole range, and the total is held between fully dry and fully wet

outputs.text: The dry and reverberated signals mixed, with the DC offset taken out
